# Gipsy.Dev — Adam Fairuz Akmal Aryaguna

> Portfolio website of Adam Fairuz Akmal Aryaguna (Gipsy.Dev), a Fullstack Engineer, Web Developer, and AI Engineer based in Malang, Indonesia. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS featuring a Midnight Editorial design system.

The site showcases projects, professional experience, certifications, and contact information. All content is in a single-page application format.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://gipsy-dev.me/#home): Hero section with name, role, and introduction
- [About](https://gipsy-dev.me/#about): Bio, education timeline, skills, and technical expertise
- [Projects](https://gipsy-dev.me/#projects): 7 software projects including StockPP, PasarNgalam, SentinelIoT, RemindMe, FruitCheck, IT Solution, and Gipsy.Dev portfolio
- [Experience](https://gipsy-dev.me/#experience): Organizational roles at HMPSTI VOKASI UB and DPM Vokasi Universitas Brawijaya
- [Certifications](https://gipsy-dev.me/#certifications): 19 professional certifications in AI, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Programming, and more
- [Contact](https://gipsy-dev.me/#contact): Contact form and social links

## Social Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/GipsyDanger-dev): Open source projects and repositories
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adamfairuz/): Professional profile and connections

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://gipsy-dev.me/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engine crawling
